description: Oracle views and tables accessed by the Data Collector scripts. The collection user needs SELECT access to these objects. Role-based grants (e.g. SELECT_CATALOG_ROLE) may not work inside PL/SQL; use SELECT ANY DICTIONARY or direct object grants instead.
cdbAdditionalGrant: ALTER USER <user> SET CONTAINER_DATA = ALL CONTAINER = CURRENT;

permissions.description: Basic instance and database identification. Required for all collections.

views.name: v$database
views.description: Database name, DBID, CDB flag, database role

views.name: v$version
views.description: Oracle edition and full version banner

permissions.description: CPU, memory, and system configuration. Required for TCO compute sizing.

views.name: v$parameter
views.description: cpu_count, sga_target, sga_max_size, pga_aggregate_target, pga_aggregate_limit, memory_target

permissions.description: Database file sizes, tablespace layout, and redo logs. Required for TCO storage analysis.
Pluggable database inventory. pdbList will be empty if inaccessible.

views.name: v$pdbs
views.description: List of pluggable databases in the CDB

permissions.notes: Only applicable to Container Databases (CDB). Requires CONTAINER_DATA = ALL for cross-container visibility in Oracle 21c+. Non-CDB (traditional) databases do not have PDBs.

permissions.description: Standby database detection and details. standbyDatabases will be empty if inaccessible.
permissions.notes: Only applicable when Oracle Data Guard is configured. Non-Data Guard setups skip these checks entirely.

permissions.description: ASM disk group details including sizes and redundancy.

views.name: v$asm_diskgroup
views.description: ASM disk group sizes and redundancy type

permissions.notes: Only queried when ASM storage is detected. Non-ASM setups (filesystem, NFS, iSCSI) skip this check. Requires connection to the ASM instance or SELECT ANY DICTIONARY.

permissions.appliesTo: Enterprise Edition with Diagnostics Pack license
permissions.description: AWR snapshots and performance metrics for I/O, throughput, and active sessions sizing.

views.name: dba_hist_snapshot
views.description: AWR snapshot metadata (time ranges, snap IDs)

views.name: dba_hist_sysmetric_summary
views.description: Per-snapshot average and peak I/O rates, throughput, and active sessions

permissions.notes: Only used on Enterprise Edition with a valid Diagnostics Pack license (control_management_pack_access = DIAGNOSTIC or DIAGNOSTIC+TUNING). If AWR views are inaccessible, the collector falls back to Statspack. Also referenced in diagnostics: dba_hist_wr_control (snap_interval, retention).

permissions.appliesTo: Standard Edition, or Enterprise Edition without Diagnostics Pack
permissions.description: Statspack snapshots and performance metrics. Used as primary source on Standard Edition or as fallback when AWR is unavailable.

views.name: stats$snapshot
views.description: Statspack snapshot metadata (time ranges, snap IDs)

views.name: stats$sysstat
views.description: Cumulative system statistics per snapshot (I/O, DB time)

views.name: stats$osstat
views.description: OS statistics per snapshot (CPU busy/idle time for utilization)

permissions.notes: Statspack tables are owned by the PERFSTAT schema. Grant SELECT on perfstat.stats$* tables or use SELECT ANY DICTIONARY. Not applicable if Statspack is not installed.
